learner_operation: Identify every true statement by applying the invertible matrix theorem to a square matrix, inferring invertibility from the given determinant, full column space, full rank, nonzero homogeneous solution, or explicit null-space parametrization.

fixed_features.feature: Square real matrix, three claims, moderate theorem inference
fixed_features.justification: Introduction tutorial 3522 states the square-matrix equivalences; every captured question asks three claims without row reduction.

fixed_features.feature: Nonzero homogeneous witness; independent one/two-direction explicit nullspace
fixed_features.justification: A zero witness provides no singularity information. Source e-5424 and q-142358/q-142474 establish exact nullity only from independent parametrizations. Keeping independence preserves immediate counting workload.

fixed_features.feature: Complete source radio banks and source-backed None checkbox option
fixed_features.justification: Response contract is source evidence; eligible true subset identities are allowed to vary within each bank. Complete source q-142367 must not be removed because one distractor has a correctable typographic label.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Zero/nonzero changes invertibility with fixed dimension and candidate claims. Nonzero sign/magnitude is irrelevant to the response.

stages_examined: generator rejection and bounded seeded resampling
shared publisher normalization, validation and content/inventory deduplication
learner freshness and difficulty-weighted selection rules, with faithful all-moderate selector reproduction
actual UI control sequence and radio choice hashing
delivery.result: 480 -> 455 independent survivors; exact runner batch 5 -> 5; six controlled records 6 -> 6. No stage repairs the exact-batch content cue. Captured bank contains 17 original source questions and no generated instances. Learner selector has no balancing by truth mask/claim identity.

limitations: Finite audit cannot prove absence of every shortcut.
Exact-batch cue is demonstrated on two members of a recognizable subgroup; it is not evidence that the generator always has this defect.

Captured inventory lacks policy settings, learner history, future generated entity IDs and live collision data. Selection code and surrogate-ID reproduction establish possible weighting/freshness effects, not live learner frequencies.

q-34936 lacks captured correct-answer and solution; independently II only follows from full column space, but exact solution fidelity cannot be verified. Canonical e-5424 lacks a captured answer bank.
Raw serialized radio-choice positions are not live UI positions; UI hashes item/field/choice identities. Literal-answer/content probes avoid treating those positions as fixed.
